newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD HIGH JUMP CHAMPION SOTOMAYOR.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD HIGH JUMP CHAMPION SOTOMAYOR.

text.p: Profile of Javier Sotomayor, who won the world high jump title on Wednesday.
World record of 2.45 metres set in 1993 in Salamanca still stands. Has jumped 2.30 metres or higher in over 200 meetings since 1984.
Won the Olympic title in 1992 and the world title the following year.
Hampered by knee, foot and ankle injuries in 1995 and 1996. Finished 11th at last year's OIympics in Atlanta.
